comment: Hand-written implementations the generated protocol is verified against. Pin commits, never branches: a branch citation silently rots, which invalidated our overrides twice during the 1.26.40 migration. Bump deliberately and re-run the gate, never as a drive-by.

gophertunnel.note: master with PR 481 (1.26.40 protocol) merged. Verified CurrentProtocol = 2168.

cloudburst.note: Secondary cross-check only. Not fetched by CI; used locally when adjudicating a divergence. Stale for some packets (PlayerAuthInput still inherits v766's bitmask), so treat silence as no evidence rather than agreement.
